addressed_weaknesses: Bundled reuse SKU (W1/Q1): added a Section 4.2 paragraph and a Table 1 row with a back-of-envelope decomposition, labelled as a derivation from logged values and not a model run. Reused SSDs give 4,912 of the 5,552 kgCO2e gross embodied reduction (88%). Reused DIMMs give 640, about 540 net of the +100 platform delta. The 5% CXL slowdown costs about 95,511 x (1/0.95-1) = 5.0 tCO2e of operational carbon per node on the mixed grid. The tornado gives 5.88% at multiplier 1.0 versus 0.93% at 0.95. DRAM-over-CXL reuse would pay only below about 10 t of operational carbon per node. A SKU with reused SSDs and new local DRAM might save roughly 5%; this is stated as a hypothesis and future work, since no such SKU was run. Caveats: new-DIMM failures, attribution of the power deltas, and SSD embodied sensitivity (-2.49% at 150 kg). The abstract, conclusion and limitations now say that the results apply to the bundle

Confounded failure-blind baseline (W2/Q2): the text now states that Y_naive = -0.557% when reused parts are charged as new (X = 0). The failure-blind break-evens (m ~2.1, mu ~1.39) therefore mostly measure the cost of ignoring drains. A failure-blind no-reuse replay was not run; an indicative difference (0.195+0.557 ~0.75 pp, close to Y) is given and marked as indicative only. Abstract, scope paragraph, contributions, Table 1 caption, Figure 3 caption and conclusion reworded to match
